evidence.text: UAE private employers must pay wages through the Wage Protection System. Under MOHRE Resolution 340 of 2026 (from 1 June 2026), any payment after the due date counts as delayed and the company is put under electronic monitoring.

messages.text: Honestly? At month 1, arrived and started on site [E-A-001]. Most of what I'm learning is supervising and planning work [ev_A_006]. My role these days: experienced crew member [ev_A_006]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. At month 5, picked up extra shifts [E-B-001]. Most of what I'm learning is leading a shift [ev_B_004]. My role these days: shift lead or certified tradesperson [ev_B_004]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: unpaid wages or a cancelled contract far from home [ev_A_010]. Stress? medium [ev_A_009]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
